classes_laptop-a-desc: In excellent condition, almost like new with minimal wear. Minimal wear is allowed (1-2 light scratches), without any problems on the screen. The screen cannot have white spots or other similar problems (lines, discoloration, dead pixels, scratches).
classes_laptop-a--desc: Preserved appearance with normal signs of use. The screen has no marks, but minor scratches or scuffs on the case are possible.
classes_laptop-b-desc-1: Signs of daily use, no deep scratches or breaks/cracks on the case. The laptops are fully functional.
classes_laptop-b-list-1: Small bumps or dents on top or bottom
classes_laptop-b-list-2: The chassis is strong and has no bends.
classes_laptop-b-list-3: The laptop may have traces of removed security or other stickers.
classes_laptop-b-list-4: There may be signs of wear on the underside of the laptop.

classes_laptop-b-list-7: It can be seen well, at arm's length.
classes_laptop-b-list-8: There may be dark/light spots and a few dead pixels.
classes_laptop-c-desc-1: Traces of permanent work. Laptops are visibly in poor condition but fully functional.
classes_laptop-c-list-1: The chassis may be slightly dented.
classes_laptop-c-list-2: Cracks/Fratures that do not interfere with the overall structure.
